right_reference_anchor_registration.note: Feature consistency only; not proof of correct camera identity or metric accuracy.

sample_strategy: First, midpoint, and last path node, or shared-prefix node
limitations: The model comes from small handpicked, agent-labelled 2022 clips and is not an independent 2024 event classifier.
A stone-like patch does not prove delivery, and a weak patch does not disprove a stone.
Only three path points are sampled; appearance may change between them.
